summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test, and a Literal test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) using the shared venv. Nothing is committed. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type checking and formatting were checked by reading only. A guard raise for non-node input may be flagged as unreachable under warn_unreachable, since the parameter is typed Node.
